title: video.run params (not complete CLI request)
$comment: Strict shared structure; normalize validates absolute paths, half-open ranges, sampling, SHA/resource closure and full output budget. HDR is an explicit Standard100 technical route with virtual mastering; measured mastering, device viewing and complete normative certification are not implied.
